messages.text: Thursday, October 8 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn Sky, Ancient Myths, and First Responder Support

A mostly clear autumn day offers a high near 70°F, perfect for enjoying local events or looking skyward. This week, state funding is directed towards first responder mental health, and NASA's Roman telescope clears a major review.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:39 AM and sunset is at 7:03 PM, under a waning crescent moon with 6.6% illumination.
Arts and Music Around Town

In Ypsilanti, the EMU Theatre presents 'Metamorphoses' at the Sponberg Theatre at 7:00 PM. For music lovers, Jordan Blanchard plays a free happy hour concert at Ann Arbor's North Star Lounge starting at 5:30 PM.
Pop's birthday is coming up on October 12.
State Funds for First Responder Mental Health

A statewide initiative to support the mental health of first responders will receive $1.044 million. Funds will be awarded to Frontline Strong Together for police officers, firefighters, EMS personnel, and other critical support staff.
Looking Ahead: Music and History
Tomorrow, catch Scythian at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM, or explore history with the 'If Stones Could Talk' Oakwood Cemetery Tours in Northville starting at 5:00 PM.
Autonomous Navigation and Telescope Readiness

NASA's Starling satellites successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting an August 30 launch.
The schedule for Starship's next launch is unset.
Seek out a quiet moment of observation today.
Friday, October 9 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, a whitefish crisis, and the cosmos await
Today will be overcast and mild, with a high near 71°F. The local focus is on the ongoing Great Lakes whitefish crisis, while science offers new insights into autonomous space navigation.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 71°F and a low around 44°F; there is a 4% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:40 AM and sunset is at 7:02 PM, under a new moon that is 2.3% illuminated.
Arts, Music, and History Nearby

The Northville Art House offers "If Stones Could Talk Oakwood Cemetery Tours" at 5:00 PM, a unique historical experience with an art exhibition opening. For music lovers, catch the William Hooker Quartet at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:00 PM.
Pop's Birthday is coming up on October 12.
State Funds Allocated for Local Initiatives

Recent state funding includes $1.044 million for a First Responder Mental Health Initiative and $1.3 million for low-income workers' health coverage. Additional funds are directed towards workforce development and housing in various regions.
Tomorrow's Events and Beyond

Tomorrow, consider the "Metamorphoses" theatre production at Sponberg Theatre in Ypsilanti or "The Voice of Whitney: A Symphonic Celebration" at the Detroit Opera House. The "WOMXNHOUSE Detroit" art exhibition also opens tomorrow.
Spacecraft Navigate Without GPS, Roman Telescope Ready

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star tracking. Meanwhile, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review and is proceeding to final launch preparations.
The next Starship launch is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026, though this is an independent estimate and not an official SpaceX schedule.
A quiet afternoon can hold a universe of discovery.
